title: Madero y la revolución
goal: Read how Francisco Madero's Plan de San Luis Potosí triggered the uprising that ended Díaz's 34-year rule, and how Madero's caution as president sowed the seeds of new conflict.

items: Explain who Madero was and why he seemed an unlikely revolutionary.
State what the Plan de San Luis Potosí called for.
Explain what Madero soon demanded of his former allies, and why.
